description: Shows a building model in 3D inside the conversation: turn it, look at single storeys or a cut-away view. Without project_id it shows VEDUTUM’s example house „Haus Lindenweg“ (no account needed); with project_id a project of the connected account. Returns a short summary for clients without the view.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it

name: vedutum_view_model
title: Show a 3D model
